boundary_refinements.bukhari:2375:hi: Exact boundary authoring preserves the frozen first-pass description but separates the finite Ibn Jurayj inquiry event from the following cut-and-took predicate. The Hindi field lacks the question, respondent and object link in that seam. Separate qualified components make those gaps visible; no text or identity is filled from Urdu.
boundary_refinements.bukhari:2382:hi: The named Dawud uncertainty is kept as its own transmitter-qualified component after the report’s two actual threshold alternatives. The trailing earlier-discussion pointer alone remains context.
boundary_refinements.bukhari:2382:ur: The named Dawud uncertainty is kept as its own transmitter-qualified component after the report’s two actual threshold alternatives. The trailing earlier-discussion pointer alone remains context.

bukhari:2313.hi: Qutaybah transmission supplies two actual historical voices: Umar written endowment stipulation permitting the caretaker/friend to eat but not accumulate money, then Abdullah ibn Umar administration and gifts to the Meccan people where he stayed. Keep the distinct deed quotation and later practice components with their own source speakers, in the same endowment context; no Prophetic attribution or identity expansion. The chain is shortened and the source spells Umar as umr; do not add the longer Urdu chain or repair names.
bukhari:2313.ur: Qutaybah transmission supplies two actual historical voices: Umar written endowment stipulation permitting the caretaker/friend to eat but not accumulate money, then Abdullah ibn Umar administration and gifts to the Meccan people where he stayed. Keep the distinct deed quotation and later practice components with their own source speakers, in the same endowment context; no Prophetic attribution or identity expansion. The own full Sufyan/Amr chain was read; no chain text is borrowed into Hindi.

bukhari:2316.hi: Uqbah ibn Harith reports the brought-in person, the explicit Nuayman-or-son-of-Nuayman alternative, the Prophet instruction to those present and his own participation with shoes/sticks. Keep the named identity uncertainty and the actual eyewitness continuation, without resolving the alternative or treating this as current legal advice. The shortened and grammatically damaged opening chain is preserved literally.

The complete own chain and eyewitness first-person wording remain literal.

bukhari:2317.hi: Aisha reports her own braiding, the Prophet putting on the necklaces and sending the animals with her father. Keep her father pronominal relation without supplying an unprinted name. The parenthetical Meccan sacrifice destination/purpose supplies an actual event domain, and because-of-this-sending limits the final permission statement; both meaningful clauses remain. No blanket halal claim is created by removing the cause.

bukhari:2325.hi: Abu Hurayrah reports the Ansar proposal, Prophetic refusal, work/share offer and acceptance. The two Muhajir/Muhajirin parenthetical labels identify the actual recipients and addressee within this dialogue, not an unrelated dictionary definition; retain this source-conditioned actor scope. No actor name is supplied from another entry. This Hindi field has a Latin-script opening chain followed by Devanagari body. Preserve the mixed source exactly and qualify the observed mixed form; do not mark the whole field as Latin or normalize it. The defective garden/work spellings remain unchanged.
bukhari:2325.ur: Abu Hurayrah reports the Ansar proposal, Prophetic refusal, work/share offer and acceptance. The two Muhajir/Muhajirin parenthetical labels identify the actual recipients and addressee within this dialogue, not an unrelated dictionary definition; retain this source-conditioned actor scope. No actor name is supplied from another entry. Read the complete own Urdu field, including both recipient/addressee labels and reciprocal fruit-sharing predicates.

bukhari:2327.hi: Rafi ibn Khadij supplies the historical land/yield arrangement, opposite crop-loss possibilities, a passive we-were-forbidden clause and absence of gold/silver rental at that time. The field does not name the person imposing the prohibition: type the actual Companion report and qualify that passive attribution, rather than inventing an explicit Prophetic speaker. Keep the yield/production parentheses because they distinguish taking produce from acquiring the land parcel.

bukhari:2329.hi: Abdullah ibn Umar supplies a finite report of the Prophet agreement with the Khaybar inhabitants for half the fruit and grain yield. Retain the precise parties, fraction and both crop categories. No definition or apparatus beyond honorifics is present.
bukhari:2329.ur: Abdullah ibn Umar supplies a finite report of the Prophet agreement with the Khaybar inhabitants for half the fruit and grain yield. Retain the precise parties, fraction and both crop categories. No definition or apparatus beyond honorifics is present.

bukhari:2332.hi: Rafi ibn Khadij reports the unequal land-yield allocation, opposite outcome risks and an explicitly named Prophetic prohibition of that arrangement. Keep actual my/yours allocation and its causal setting. Unlike the separate2327 field, this own field names the Prophet; no wording or attribution is transferred between occurrences. The own chain is shorter and printed wording defective in places; preserve it literally.

bukhari:2334.hi: The actual Umar saying is a counterfactual about later Muslims and distributing conquered towns, with his explicit comparison to the Prophet Khaybar distribution. Type it as Umar speech containing that comparison, not new direct Prophetic speech. The appended ellipsis plus hadith-related-chapters heading and topic title are source metadata context, outside the actual report. Keep the exact actual counterfactual and quoted example; the final related-chapters label/topic is not narration.

Preserve the duplication and source words with an explicit defect annotation; do not silently deduplicate or fill identity.

bukhari:2345.hi: Ibn Umar states his knowledge of earlier sharecropping; the following narrative describes his fear of a possible later instruction and precautionary discontinuance. Preserve the uncertainty as possibility, not a claim that a new prohibition occurred. Keep the precaution parenthesis because it qualifies his actual motivation. Distinguish the Companion testimony from the reporting voice describing his later concern/action within the same account.

bukhari:2346.hi: The field supplies an actual past land-yield arrangement and Prophetic prohibition, then a separately reported question to Rafi and his actual dinar/dirham permission answer. Preserve those source-bound report/dialogue components. The terminal Layth legal appraisal explains why the arrangement would not be lawful; it is appended legal commentary context, not another narrated event or Prophetic wording. The initial attribution lacks the Rafi/two-uncles link printed in Urdu. Keep the first historical report through the supplied Hanzalah framing with that gap explicit; never insert the uncles or reconstruct missing text. Preserve the printed dinner/dirhaim coin spellings.

bukhari:2347.hi: This entire own field was read separately, even though it repeats the supplied2346 account. Retain the historical crop-yield arrangement and expressly reported Prophetic prohibition, then the actual question to Rafi and his dinar/dirham answer as distinct source components. Keep the appended Layth legal appraisal as explanation context. Do not merge the occurrence with2346. The own opening leaves the Rafi/two-uncles link unprinted. bukhari:2349.hi: Sahl ibn Sad reports Friday happiness, the old woman crop/food preparation and communal meal/siesta timing. Abu Hazim explicitly states uncertainty whether Sahl supplied the no-fat/no-grease description. Preserve that named substantive memory qualification as its own transmitter voice within the same report family, between the Sahl narrative and its resumption; do not select the food description as certain or infer Prophetic speech. The this-matter parenthesis is coherent narrative linking, not a dictionary gloss.

bukhari:2351.hi: Sahl reports the actual milk/water cup, right-side young boy, left-side elders, request for permission, boy refusal and giving it to him. Retain exact relative positions and permission dialogue; the boy is unnamed and no familiar identity is borrowed. No source apparatus requiring separation beyond exact honorifics is present. The source has a shortened chain, defective bairan target wording and jhoothe spelling. Preserve these literally rather than repairing from Urdu.

The actual elders wording and supplied residue spelling are preserved exactly.

Retain the actual narrated motive and every relative position without inventing the Bedouin identity or converting the narrator explanation to an extra Prophetic quotation.

The parenthetic blessing on Abu Bakr is a standard exact source honorific, retained.

bukhari:2366.hi: Sahl reports a cup, youngest boy on the right, older Companions on the left and actual permission/refusal/handing-over dialogue. Keep the boy unnamed and preserve the own speech referring to remaining water; do not import the milk/water introduction from2351 or merge the two source IDs.

Separate the embedded later Ibn Jurayj/Ibn Shihab inquiry from the Ali narrative and its resumption; do not attribute the transmitter first person to Ali. Retain the final before-wine-prohibition chronology as a qualified source narrative scope voice in the same family, not Prophetic speech. The botanical definition of idhkhir and repeated Ansari-house identity label are context. The intention bridge, forthcoming marriage relation and explicit Ibn Jurayj speaker label are meaningful narrative/voice qualifications. The own source has a shortened chain and damaged lyric/action seam, plus a missing question/object connector in the later inquiry. Preserve its finite supplied fragments with explicit source-gap and attribution qualifications, never fill the complete lyric, hamzah-action wording or hump-meat question from Urdu. The resumed Ali pain statement is abbreviated but actually supplied.

The terminal Urdu footnote marker is apparatus context, while the complete question and prohibition remain selected. Urdu has a malformed connective in the approach-to-camel clause; preserve it verbatim. Neither field's wording is repaired from the other.
